definition: Authored before any MinerU run. A start is the exact normalized title on its physical one-based page; distinct titles disambiguate positions on the same page. Level is authored hierarchy. Provider Block sequence is measured, never guessed.
hierarchy_note: In each nonempty document, Opening/1 Introduction and Closing/2 Results are roots; Scope/1.1 Constraints is a child of the first root. End boundaries are not measured by this issue; no provider-specific Block sequence is part of the authored truth.
